decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The use of the hereby approved detached outbuilding shall be incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 10 Somerset Waye, Hounslow and shall be used for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities).
description: Retention of single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
